data.name: Virtual Fighter Maneuvers
data.detailed_description:
Virtual Fighter Maneuvers is a VR combat flight simulator from the creator of VTOL VR. Focused on short-range air-to-air engagements, you can launch directly into the merge with bots or other players online.

Fly high performance fighter jets in intense dogfights with realistic flight and weapon physics. Aircraft and missiles are simulated with realistic effects of altitude, transonic drag, angle of attack, fuel/ammo weight, etc! Manage your energy, turn rate, and positioning to gain an edge over your opponent.

Choose from 3 unique aircraft:

  • T-15 Excalibur: With two high powered engines and cropped delta wings, this air superiority fighter boasts the highest thrust and top speed.
  • T-16 Falchion: This single-engine, lightweight fighter is the king of sustained turn rate, giving it an edge in two-circle fights.
  • T-18 Cutlass: Able to achieve an aggressive angle of attack, this naval multi-role jet dominates in lower speed one-circle fights.

Learning the strengths and weaknesses of each aircraft is crucial to mastering the art of air combat.

Take Control

Interact with the cockpit and fly the aircraft with the virtual controls or bind your gamepad/HOTAS hardware.

Fly At Your Own Pace

Play for fun in casual game modes or compete in global ranked dogfight matches.

Climb the Leaderboard

Earn your rank and compete against players with similar skill levels.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-3570
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: Any OpenXR or SteamVR compatible device

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
